## Professional Summary
Ahmed Aqeel (DevAhmedAqeel) is a senior AI-powered Full Stack Developer, Cross-Platform Mobile App Engineer, and the Founder of DevOrbit Tech (https://devorbittech.org/). He specializes in production-ready web applications, high-performance mobile apps (iOS & Android), custom logo & graphic branding, automated n8n AI agent workflows, Python web scraping, and scalable backend infrastructure.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Full Stack Web Development
- Technologies: React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, TailwindCSS, Bootstrap.
- Offerings: SaaS applications, custom CMS, e-commerce stores, responsive client web portals, API architecture.

### 2. Cross-Platform Mobile App Development
- Technologies: React Native, Flutter, Expo, Dart, iOS & Android deployment.
- Offerings: Native-feel mobile apps, offline synchronization, push notifications, secure biometric authentication, in-app purchases.

### 3. Graphic Designing, Brand Identity & Logo Design
- Technologies: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, UI/UX Wireframing, Vector Design.
- Offerings: Modern custom logo design, comprehensive brand guidelines, typography palettes, UI design system prototypes, social media kits.

### 4. AI Agents & Workflow Automation
- Technologies: n8n, Ollama, Claude API, OpenAI GPT-4o, LangChain, Webhooks, Cron Automation.
- Offerings: Autonomous business workflows, custom AI chatbots, lead enrichment pipelines, automated CRM syncing.

### 5. Python Automation & Enterprise Web Scraping
- Technologies: Python 3, Selenium, Beautiful Soup, Playwright, Pandas, REST APIs.
- Offerings: Automated scheduled web scrapers, data cleaning pipelines, headless browser tasks, automated report generation.

### 6. Cloud Databases & Backend Infrastructure
- Technologies: Firebase (Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions), Supabase (PostgreSQL, Realtime, Row-Level Security), MongoDB, REST & GraphQL APIs.
- Offerings: Real-time database modeling, serverless endpoints, authentication logic, cloud backups.
